learning_outcomes.text: Understand and schematize simple physical phenomena involving particles and rigid bodies using mathematical models.
Acquire the aptitude to learn, with a critical mind, the teachings typical of the Mechanical Engineering degree.

syllabus_topics: Statics and dynamics of the element
Statics and dynamics of the rigid body
Statics and dynamics of the articulate systems
assessment_rules: The final grade v(f) is calculated as (3/5)v(1) + (2/5)v(2), where v(1) is the grade for the first written test and v(2) for the second. If v(f) is below 18/30, the exam is not passed. If v(f) is at least 18/30 but v(1) or v(2) is below 16/30, an oral test is mandatory. Otherwise, the exam is passed, but students can optionally take an oral test to achieve 'cum laude'.
bibliography: P.Biscari, T.Ruggeri, G.Saccomanni, M.Vianello "Meccanica razionale per l'ingegneria"
P.Benvenuti, G.Maschio "Complementi ed esercizi di meccanica razionale"
